priority: Lethal outcome suppresses contact/hurt/jump/landing and uses shared death once. Accepted nonlethal damage uses ride_impact instead of hurt tone; suppress same-frame landing. Immune/repeated contact emits neither impact nor death.

Retry clears dedup/cooldowns/stops stale voices and restarts bed only when ride active. Stop/dispose bed/contact on death/title/scene exit/finish. Existing death voice follows its established lifecycle; do not stop it immediately when ride stops on death.
